author: Inside Edition
description: Are these nests a sign that war between Russia and Ukraine has become too normal? CBS News reports they were found on the frontline between the two nations. They're a mix of grass and fiber optic cable which is used to communicate to drones. Scientists say they're shocked to see what the animals have created. One of the nests is reportedly on display at Kyiv's War Museum. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Birds Make Nests From Fiber Optic Wires Found On Frontline Of Ukraine War

author: Inside Edition
description: While one might think Miss Norma Swan of Wisconsin has long outgrown a Disney-themed birthday party, friends and family say her 101st birthday called for a '101 Dalmations' celebration. While she credits her long life to exercise, her loved ones say she brought positivity and gratitude everywhere she went. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: 101-Year-Old Woman Celebrates Birthday With 101 Dalmations-Themed Party
